```plato

// A topological ordering of a directed graph. IsValid is false when the graph
// contains a cycle, in which case OrderedVertexIndices is partial or empty.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Topological_sorting)
type TopologicalOrder
    implements IValue
{
    OrderedVertexIndices: Array<GraphVertexIndex>;
    IsValid: Boolean;
}
```
